Data source setup (one time)

To let the map update automatically, publish the ABC-ALL sheet as CSV:

  1. In Google Sheets: File → Share → Publish to web
  2. Select the ABC-ALL sheet and CSV format (not "Entire Document")
  3. Click Publish and copy the link
